content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD mixing_salatin.F (header still says 'FILE mixing.F', L3): Chen/Salatin variant of the time-averaging module with dual averaging clocks and vorticity statistics. MIXING_STUFF (L53-70) calls CALCULATE_MEAN with an explicit 33-item argument list (L61-67) once time >= STEADY_TIME (L60). CALCULATE_MEAN (L84-240) takes dummy arguments (declarations L96-114, including Chen/Salatin additions NumDT1/NumDT2 counters L108, vorticity arrays Vor_Instant/Vor_Mean/Vor_Intensity L109, Vor2/Vor2sum/Vorsum L110, local Vor_Variance L111, ETA statistics arrays L112-113, SigWaveHeight L114) and maintains two clocks: T_sum for wave height/MSL (L116) and T_sumUVmean for velocity and vorticity (L117). Eta branch: when T_sum >= T_INTV_mean (L119) it finishes ETAsum/ETAmean (L123-124), computes the sample-variance form ETAvariance = 1/(NumDT1-1)*ETA2sum - ETAmean^2*NumDT1/(NumDT1-1) (L127-128), SigWaveHeight = 4.0*SQRT(ETAvariance) (L131), resets ETAsum/ETA2sum/NumDT1 to ZERO and decrements T_sum by T_INTV_mean (L132-135), computes zero-upcrossing WaveHeightAve = HavgSum/Num_Zero_Up and WaveHeightRMS = SQRT(HrmsSum/Num_Zero_Up) where Num_Zero_Up>=2 (L138-148, per-interval resets commented out L144-146), and calls PREVIEW_MEAN (L150); otherwise it accumulates NumDT1 (L154), ETAsum (L155), ETA2=ETA^2 (L158) into ETA2sum (L161), running ETAmean=ETAsum/T_sum (L165, comment: effective for long simulations), and performs per-cell zero-upcrossing detection using Emax/Emin tracking (L169-170), Tmpe=Eta-ETAmean vs Tmp_0=Eta0-ETAmean upcrossing test (L171-173), Num_Zero_Up increment (L174), HavgSum += Emax-Emin and HrmsSum += (Emax-Emin)^2 from the second crossing (L175-178), then Emax=-1000., Emin=1000. resets (L180-181). UV/vorticity branch (header comment PREVIEW_UVMEAN, U,V preferably averaged over 2Tp, L188-198): when T_sumUVmean >= T_INTV_UVmean (L200) it finalizes Usum/Vsum and Umean=Usum/T_sumUVmean, Vmean=Vsum/T_sumUVmean (L201-204), Vorsum=Vor_Instant*DT+Vorsum with Vor_Mean=Vorsum/T_sumUVmean (L207-209; count-based alternatives commented L206, L208), vorticity sample variance Vor_Variance = 1/(NumDT2-1)*Vor2sum - Vor_Mean^2*NumDT2/(NumDT2-1) and Vor_Intensity=SQRT(Vor_Variance) (L212-214), decrements T_sumUVmean by T_INTV_UVmean and zeros Usum/Vsum/Vorsum/Vor2sum/NumDT2 (L218-223), calls PREVIEW_MEAN_UV (L224); otherwise accumulates Usum/Vsum (L226-227), NumDT2 (L229), Vorsum (L231) and Vor2=Vor_Instant^2 into Vor2sum (L234-237).

unresolved: File header comment still says 'FILE mixing.F' (L3) although this is mixing_salatin.F; relation to the plain mixing.F build variant (which file is compiled) is decided outside this file.

Cross-line mixed weighting: ETA2sum accumulates unweighted ETA^2 samples (L158-161) and is divided by count NumDT1 (L127-128), while ETAsum is DT-weighted and divided by time T_sum (L123-124); the variance formula therefore mixes a count-normalized second moment with a time-normalized mean, exact only for uniform DT. Same mixture in the vorticity branch: Vorsum is DT-weighted / T_sumUVmean (L207-209) but Vor2sum is count-based / NumDT2 (L212-213, L234-237); commented-out count-based Vorsum lines (L206, L208) show the alternative.

Cross-line: T_sum and T_sumUVmean are declared INTENT(OUT) (L103) but are read before being written (L116-117, L119, L200) - with INTENT(OUT) their values on entry are formally undefined in Fortran; the code relies on them behaving as INOUT.
NumDT1=ZERO and NumDT2=ZERO assign the (presumably real) PARAM constant ZERO to INTEGER counters (L134, L223); ZERO is defined in USE PARAM outside this file.
Division by real(NumDT1-1) (L127) and real(NumDT2-1) (L212) is unguarded; on the first finalize with NumDT1<=1 or NumDT2<=1 this divides by zero or is negative-weighted.
Per-interval resets of Num_Zero_Up/HavgSum/HrmsSum are commented out (L144-146), so WaveHeightAve/RMS are cumulative since STEADY_TIME.
Vor_Instant is INTENT(INOUT) (L109) but only read here (L207, L231, L234); where it is computed is external to this file.
